sections.note: The law sets 14% on taxable income up to €175,000, €24,500 plus 30% of the income above €175,000 up to €200,000, and 16% of the whole income above €200,000; the bands above give the same tax. Same rates since 2025 (17% and 15% from 2019 to 2024). A 7% employment fund surcharge comes on top (next section).

sections.title: Property tax (impôt foncier)

rows.label: What it is
rows.value: A municipal tax on all built and unbuilt property in Luxembourg, paid by the owner on 1 January of the tax year; co-owners are jointly liable

rows.label: Base
rows.value: The unit value (valeur unitaire) set by the ACD from 1941 rental values, indexed, times a base rate (taux d'assiette) set by law by type and location of the property

rows.label: Tax
rows.value: Base × the commune's multiplier (taux communal), set each year by each commune for category A and category B or its classes B1 to B6

sections.title: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property

rows.label: Corporate income tax (impôt sur le revenu des collectivités) [national]
rows.value: 14% up to €175,000, 16% above €200,000 (€24,500 + 30% in between), plus the 7% employment fund surcharge; municipal business tax 3% × the commune's multiplier (225% to 350%; Luxembourg City 225%); combined 23.87% in Luxembourg City; minimum net wealth tax €535 to €4,815; 15% global minimum tax with a national top-up tax for groups with revenue of at least €750,000,000. Paid by resident companies and Luxembourg branches of foreign companies. L.I.R. art. 159, 160 and 174; loi modifiée du 30 juin 1976 (fonds pour l'emploi); Gewerbesteuergesetz (GewStG, municipal business tax); loi du 22 décembre 2023 relative à l'imposition minimale effective.

source.title: ACD: Tarif applicable aux collectivités (impôt sur le revenu des collectivités), last updated 12/02/2025; L.I.R. art. 174, texte coordonné en vigueur au 1er janvier 2026 (date d'actualisation 08/05/2026)

rows.label: Tax on distributed profits and branch profits [national]
rows.value: branch profits: corporate income tax at the normal rates, no separate branch tax; dividends: 15% withholding tax, with a participation exemption. Paid by shareholders (withheld by the paying company). L.I.R. art. 146 to 149, 156 and 160.

source.title: ACD: L.I.R., texte coordonné en vigueur au 1er janvier 2026 (date d'actualisation 08/05/2026), art. 146, 156, 160 and 174

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (CCSS, non-salariés) [national]
rows.value: pension 17%, health 5.6% plus 0.5%, dependency 1.4% (no ceiling), accident 0.65% base rate; between the social minimum wage and 5× it per month (accessory activity: one third); Mutualité des employeurs optional. Paid by self-employed people (both shares, on their professional income). CCSS: Avis aux non-salariés (contribution rates from 1 January 2026) and affiliation rules.

source.title: CCSS: Avis aux non-salariés, Taux de cotisation au 01.01.2026 (13 mars 2026)

rows.label: Contractor or employee: the subordination test and withholding on fees [national]
rows.value: employment where there is subordination, work and pay; no withholding on fees to resident contractors; 20% withholding on directors' fees; 10% on non-resident artists and sportspersons. Paid by clients and companies paying the fees (withholding); contractors pay quarterly advances. L.I.R. art. 135 and 152; the employment-contract test described on Guichet.lu.

source.title: Guichet.lu: Contrat à durée indéterminée (CDI), last modified 04.06.2026

rows.label: Simplified or flat-rate regimes for small businesses [national]
rows.value: none for income tax (profits taxed on the progressive scale); VAT franchise for turnover up to €50,000 a year. Paid by no one: the franchise is an exemption. L.I.R. (one scale for all income); AED rules on the small-business VAT franchise.

source.title: ACD: Barèmes, 1.3 Explications (last updated 18/04/2025)

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
rows.value: wage tax at the normal scale on pay for work in Luxembourg, withheld by the employer (class 1 or 1a; married: class 1); resident treatment on request where at least 90% of worldwide income is taxable in Luxembourg; 34-day telework thresholds with France, Belgium and Germany. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). L.I.R. art. 2, 156, 157, 157bis and 157ter.

source.title: ACD: L.I.R., texte coordonné en vigueur au 1er janvier 2026 (date d'actualisation 08/05/2026), art. 2, 156, 157, 157bis and 157ter

rows.label: Property tax (impôt foncier) [municipal]
rows.value: unit value × base rate × the commune's multiplier; 2026 multipliers from 105% to 4000% by class and commune (Luxembourg City 250% to 750%). Paid by owners on 1 January. Loi modifiée sur l'impôt foncier du 1er décembre 1936 (Grundsteuergesetz).

source.title: ACD: Impôt foncier (last updated 24/01/2017); Guichet.lu: Impôt foncier (last modified 13.10.2022)

rows.label: Property transfer duties: registration and transcription duty (droits d'enregistrement et de transcription) [national]
rows.value: 6% registration plus 1% transcription; Bëllegen Akt credit of €40,000 per buyer for an own home; Luxembourg City surcharge of 50% of the registration duty on non-residential property. Paid by the buyer. Registration and transcription duties collected by the AED; loi modifiée du 30 juillet 2002 (crédit d'impôt); Ville de Luxembourg règlement-taxe.
